scope: Source grouping explains which integration/culling paths named representative scenes exercise; it never passes unshown object types.

streamed static meshes.behavior: All prepared mesh surfaces share MapChunk budgeted creation, MapLayer insertion/removal and one Buildings3D viewport. No per-semantic-type software occlusion selector exists. Depth, frustum and material backface rules act on the individual meshes.
streamed static meshes.limit: These scenarios cover shared integration and several actual types. Rare landmarks/props not shown in those locations retain individual isolated geometry/distance evidence only. No assertion that all natural placements were visited.

live entity pool.behavior: Shared view_rect with 30 m margin filters entities before production pooled car/person/animal draws; opaque bridge overlap uses real depth at map-layer elevations. Legacy non-opaque under-bridge canvas layers are separate.
live entity pool.limit: Representative vehicle/person movement, on-foot eye and bridge context. Individual rare species/special vehicle natural spawns and every below-ground/layer combination are not promised by a deterministic pose.

interior world.behavior: One isolated 3D viewport, fixed lighting and actual capsule collision. 35 source plans/156 rooms are represented; front-door enter/leave is a UI transition, no exterior 3D interior continuity.
interior world.isolated_evidence: runtime-manifest.json:156 actual post-walk room views, prior 140 entry-camera views and all plan geometry angles
interior world.limit: No server-authorized house entry capture. Exact main-run camera poses and closed return path were lost; primary targeted reruns retained for two plans.

context canvas/shaders.behavior: Canvas Z ordering and per-feature draws remain separate from 3D depth. Actual visible UI overlays, light pools, water/shader fixtures and seasonal fields are inspected by identified target, not passed by a generic 3D scene.
context canvas/shaders.limit: All registered targets have direct isolated context captures; complete world overlay stacking and rare seasonal/event combinations remain partial.

interface canvas.behavior: Control hierarchy and custom canvas draw paths; UI does not use 3D frustum/mesh occlusion. Actual components have identified context and dynamic-state evidence.
interface canvas.limit: Local state fixtures test layout, not every server event/language/window combination.

unused imports.behavior: BMX/moped/subway GLBs are not registered for live creation.
unused imports.limit: No natural-map capture exists for an unregistered type; import alone is not reachability.

forest.direct_transition: All three forest species at 399/399.9/400.1/401 m
forest.limit: Multi-tree chunk streaming/per-instance edge transitions not exhaustively captured.

absent_software_occlusion.finding: No configured software occlusion/occluder implementation; only a descriptive comment. Normal GPU depth/frustum/backface behavior is present.

interpretation: Spec 5 explicitly requests representative gameplay cameras. Source grouping supports representative checks of shared creation, visibility and removal paths. It does not certify every natural map instance; each individual renderer target still retains its own eight-angle/context/distance evidence and partial/defect status.
